primaryAudience: executive sponsor at a regional cooperative
viewerDecision: whether to approve the three-phase close programme
primaryTakeaway: Approve a three-phase programme that halves the close.

audioDirection.pauses: hold each number for a beat

limitations: Fictional example for planning. Every name and figure is invented.

narrative.question: what will the programme deliver, for how long and at what cost
narrative.viewerValue: the sponsor can approve with the scope, team and price in front of them

beats.narration: Approve a three-phase programme that halves the close. It runs twenty weeks.
beats.actionTitle: We recommend a twenty-week programme that halves the monthly close.
beats.supportingArgument: The recommendation leads so the sponsor can decide early.

evidenceClaims.text: Recommended programme: three phases over twenty weeks.

beats.narration: You told us the close takes four days and the numbers rarely agree.
beats.actionTitle: You asked for a close that finishes in two days with numbers that agree.
beats.supportingArgument: Playing the problem back in their words shows we listened.

evidenceClaims.text: The cooperative described a four-day close with mismatched sheets.

beats.narration: Three phases: map the close, build one ledger, hand it over.
beats.actionTitle: Three phases take the close from map to handover.
beats.supportingArgument: Each phase ends in a deliverable the sponsor can inspect.

beats.narration: Your lead is Mira Voss. She has run three closes like this one.
beats.actionTitle: Named leads run each phase and stay for the whole programme.
beats.supportingArgument: Named people make the proposal credible.

evidenceClaims.text: Fictional team of three with named roles.

beats.narration: Twenty weeks, with a go or no-go gate after each phase.
beats.actionTitle: A gate after each phase lets you stop or continue.
beats.supportingArgument: Gates cap the commitment at every step.

beats.narration: You can take the whole programme, the first two phases, or the map alone.
beats.actionTitle: Three scopes let you commit as far as you wish.
beats.supportingArgument: Choice lowers the cost of saying yes.

beats.narration: The full programme is a fixed fee. It assumes your team joins weekly reviews and excludes licence costs.
beats.actionTitle: The fixed fee states what it assumes and what it leaves out.
beats.supportingArgument: Stating limits now prevents surprises later.

evidenceClaims.text: Fixed fee range with assumptions and exclusions.

assumptions: A named finance owner joins a weekly review
Source data is available in week one
exclusions: Changes to the chart of accounts

beats.narration: Sign the statement of work by the fifteenth to start in January.
